description: This file manages database schema migrations for the application. It handles version checks, performs sequential migrations, and updates version info in shared preferences. It also triggers user notifications during migration processes.

classes.name: MigrationManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling database migrations, checking versions, and executing appropriate migration scripts while providing user notifications.

methods.name: checkAndMigrate
methods.description: Checks current database version against latest and performs migration if needed, with user notifications.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current database version from shared preferences.

methods.name: getLatestVersion
methods.description: Returns the latest available database version. To be updated as new migrations are added.

methods.name: performMigration
methods.description: Sequentially applies migration steps between versions.

methods.name: migrateV1ToV2
methods.description: Migration step from version 1 to 2; updates event timestamps.

methods.name: migrateV2ToV3
methods.description: Migration step from version 2 to 3; sets sync status for records.

methods.name: updateVersion
methods.description: Updates the stored database version in shared preferences.
